name: Corn earworm (ulod sa puso)
keywords: worm at the tip of the ear
worms at the tip of the ear
droppings at the tip of the ear
signs: Chewed silk and kernels at the tip of the ear, with many droppings
Green to brown caterpillars, often with stripes, inside the ear tip
Moldy kernels at the damaged tip; earlier, chewed leaves and tassel
actions: Check the ear tips and the silk during silking, and hand-pick the caterpillars
Plant at the same time as your neighbors, and avoid growing other host crops next to the corn
Ask the agriculturist about a light or pheromone trap to watch for moths
Protect ladybird beetles and spiders by avoiding unnecessary broad-spectrum sprays
callExpertIf: Many ears are damaged at the tip or the damage is spreading

insect.stageNote: from the whorl stage to silking, mostly at the ear tip and kernels
